title: Redaction as Cross-Regulatory Disclosure Avoidance

scopes.description: Complete author-supplied R workflow: the data-cleaning driver and then the shipped table/figure driver, including their required raw inputs, generated RDS handoffs, database queries and RStudio formatting step. Outcomes not generated by these two programs remain contextual.

requirements.description: Local Compustat historical business-segment source needed to construct the firm-year sample, with the original filer/year fields used in the FY1993–2000 design.

routes.description: Bounded local probe confirms the historical merged segment product and all consumed source columns, including business-segment type and both date keys. Export these underlying fields to the author CSV and lowercase its headers as the script does; observed row coverage and original export vintage remain later validation.
routes.expected_period: Code's source filter is after 1991-05-31 through 2010-05-31; the main sample is FY1993–2000 with adjoining pre/post years.

requirements.description: Compustat annual fundamentals used in the sample, control-variable, patent, forecast and performance constructions.

routes.description: The local COMP.FUNDA file is readable and contains the union of fields consumed by the supplied SQL, including gvkey/date, accounting measures, identifiers and the later operating-cash-flow field. Keep its date and gvkey semantics when exposing it under the `comp.funda` relation required by the code; complete observed history is a later validation.
routes.expected_period: Queries use overlapping annual windows from 1990 through 2015, with narrower return and adoption panels; retain lead-history years in the query.

requirements.description: CRSP/Compustat link-history table needed to attach permno to gvkey/date observations using the author-specified link types and effective-date bounds.

routes.description: The local CCMXPF link-history file is readable and contains the exact gvkey, link type, permno and link-date columns used by the SQL joins. Preserve the link-type allowlist and date-validity join when exposing it to the `crsp.ccmxpf_linktable` relation; unsampled historical endpoints are future validation.
routes.expected_period: Link history must cover Compustat query years and the corresponding gvkey–permno validity intervals, including 1990–2015 queries.

requirements.description: CRSP daily stock returns used to calculate firm and treatment-group portfolio excess returns around the 1996–1997 disclosure event.

routes.description: The local CRSP daily stock product is readable with permno, date and return columns. It matches the author's daily query; export or expose these exact fields and preserve the 1995-01-01 through 1997-07-05 date filter.
routes.expected_period: Daily observations queried from 1995-01-01 through 1997-07-05; event calculations retain the 1995 benchmark and 1996–1997 event windows.

requirements.description: DirectEDGAR filing metadata needed to match filings to Compustat firm-years and classify electronic 10-K/10-Q activity; the code consumes CIK, company name, report date, filing date and form.

routes.description: Author documentation names directEDGAR, and the frozen catalog query returned no directEDGAR product candidate. No access barrier is established. The required report-date field and complete author-period export remain unverified.
routes.expected_period: Author export dated 2021-12-28; code needs filing metadata for the 1993–2000 sample and a matching filing window around fiscal dates.

routes.description: The official SEC page documents public submissions history, but does not establish the author's report-date field mapping or complete history before EDGAR indexing begins. No API call or data payload was requested.
routes.expected_period: Author code needs the 1993–2000 filing population, including report and filing dates; SEC documentation must support the mapping before this route is credited.

requirements.description: M&A activity input used to exclude treated firms with adoption-window deals; the cleaner reads an SDC-named workbook and consumes target/acquiror CUSIPs plus announced, effective, and withdrawn dates.

routes.description: The readable local SDC M&A Details product exposes the five consumed roles: DATEANN (Date Announced), DATEEFF (Date Effective), DATEWITH (Date Withdrawn), ACUSIP (Acquiror CUSIP), and MASTER_CUSIP (Target CUSIP). It can be staged to the cleaner's workbook contract; date-window row coverage and the prepared workbook's header/date parsing remain validation steps.
routes.expected_period: The cleaner filters effective dates from 1997-12-15 through 1999-12-31; this is the required selection window, and row coverage should be checked after workbook staging.

requirements.description: Daily Fama/French three-factor CSV used to compute event-window excess returns and factor regressions.

routes.description: Official data-library page lists a daily three-factor CSV and the official factor description documents daily history covering the 1995–1997 author window. The code maps the file to date, Mkt-RF, SMB, HML and RF, converts dates, and scales CRSP returns to percent before subtracting RF; the CSV payload was not requested.
routes.expected_period: Daily history is documented from 1926; the author uses 1995–1997 daily returns and 1995–1997 event windows.

requirements.description: KPSS patent panel used to match patent filing dates and CRSP permno to firm-years and construct patent counts.

routes.description: The author-linked repository README documents a public patent-level panel through 2025 with the code-required patent number, filing date, CRSP permno, citation and innovation-value fields. Current data are updated relative to the script's 2020 file, so exact values remain output-fidelity validation rather than a route blocker.
routes.expected_period: Public panel is documented from 1926 through 2025; code uses the filing-date window within 365 days before selected FY1998 firm-years.

requirements.description: I/B/E/S U.S. EPS summary-history input used for quarterly and annual forecast surprises, matched by CUSIP and fiscal-period end date.

routes.description: The local U.S. I/B/E/S Summary Statistics with Actuals product is readable and contains all eight consumed underlying columns. Export to the author CSV contract, lowercase headers as the code does, and convert its SAS DATE9 fields to parseable ISO dates; preserve the FPI 6/1 branches and forecast/actual fields.
routes.expected_period: The code uses quarterly and annual forecasts for the 1998–1999 adoption window; filing/forecast date history is required for the prior and following dates selected by the joins.

issues.description: The 33 frozen checklist dependencies are mapped below, and direct SQL inputs are recorded separately. Full-pipeline closure remains unresolved because DirectEDGAR/CTO coverage, the WRDS connection bootstrap, and three proprietary hand-collected workbooks are not established; the local SDC M&A fields support ordinary workbook staging, with date-window row coverage to validate after conversion.

The author CSV requires cik, cname, rdate, cdate and doctype, including the 1993 sample. SEC indexes begin in 1994Q3 and document company/form/CIK/date-filed/file-name fields, while report-date mapping and the exact two-keyword CTO results are not established; local SEC and LM10X roots were only stat-checked.

The supplied cleaner queries comp.funda, crsp.ccmxpf_linktable and crsp.dsf through a `wrds` SQL object. Its connection/setup block is wholly withheld by the assigned source-screening rule, so the current DBI driver, bootstrap sequence and authorized connection route cannot be identified from displayed source.

The local SDC source has the consumed CUSIP/date roles, but the cleaner takes an Excel workbook with its selected headers. Stage the five fields and validate header mapping, date parsing, and row coverage for the 1997-12-15 through 1999-12-31 effective-date window.

The datasheet explicitly describes the hand-collected contract-count source as proprietary at the moment. The three workbooks are separate mandatory inputs for total non-redacted contracts, total redacted contracts and redacted-contract counts.

Both supplied R drivers retain `setwd("your folder path")` while reading `source doc/...` and `functions.R` by relative path. The package needs one coherent staged root and a concrete working-directory value before the programs can be attempted.
The table driver calls trace(..., edit = T) and directs the user to alter stargazer rows 7105 and 7106 in RStudio before continuing; this manual GUI step and RStudio availability need to be arranged.

evidence.description: Cleaner makes a WRDS SQL query against annual fundamentals and the Compustat/CRSP link table, then fetches the query result.
evidence.quote:
sql <- paste("SELECT cmp.*,cc.lpermno AS permno",
             "FROM (SELECT gvkey,datadate,fyear,conm,cusip,cik,fic,sich,sale,at,revt",
             "FROM comp.funda WHERE at IS NOT NULL and ni IS NOT NULL) cmp",
             "LEFT JOIN crsp.ccmxpf_linktable cc ON cc.LINKTYPE IN ('LU', 'LC', 'LD', 'LF', 'LN', 'LO', 'LS', 'LX') AND cmp.gvkey=cc.gvkey",
             "AND (cc.LINKDT<=cmp.datadate OR cc.LINKDT IS NULL) AND (cmp.datadate<=cc.LINKENDDT OR cc.LINKENDDT IS NULL)")
res <- dbSendQuery(wrds, sql)
tmp <- dbFetch(res, n = -1)
